attributes.additional_details: Ward End Fire Station provides vital emergency cover for Ward End and surrounding communities. We are concerned that its proposed closure could increase response times and affect community safety. We call for a full, transparent assessment of response times, local risks and the impact on residents. The station should remain open unless an alternative can demonstrably provide equal or better emergency cover.
attributes.background: The proposed closure of Ward End Fire Station is fully reviewed, with its impact on emergency response times and community safety assessed, and the station remains open unless an alternative provides equal or better emergency cover.

rejection.details:
We can’t accept petitions that call for action at a local level.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

You could also raise your issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors
